title: Language etiquette for people with special needs
html: Oral health is an integral component of systemic health and a main component of Sustainable Development Goal 3 (Good Health and Well-Being) adopted by the United Nations.1 Pain and discomfort associated with untreated dental diseases can affect quality of life, and thus, dental diseases are often an economic burden on people and society. People with special health care needs, although a part of society, encounter disparities, some of which are intentional; most, however, are unintentional. We aim to highlight one of these issues concerning people with special health care needs that pertains to communicating with them in a respectful and empowering tone and reinforcing their agency.
